content: After discharge, it is essential to provide education on self-management for diabetes as part of the discharge planning process. This education should include training on how to recognize the symptoms of hyperglycemia (high blood sugar) and hypoglycemia (low blood sugar). Patients should also receive dietary guidance tailored to their condition. Additionally, they must be instructed on the proper use of necessary medical supplies, such as insulin pens, syringes, and blood glucose meters, to ensure effective diabetes management.
